plate_comment: Computes the pilot injection quantity pilot_quantity_unscaled (0.0679 mm3 per count): the blended pilot_quantity map and the coolant, intake-temperature, ambient, boost and cold corrections are combined by sum / max / min wins (pilot_quantity_logic_select, 2 = min in the RAM dump), slew-limited, and capped at fuel_demand_computed x DAT_00409e66 / 4096 (half in the dump). The result is 0 when crank_position_valid_flag is set with the DAT_00409e62 switch on, or in the free-acceleration shutoff (coolant and intake limits are 300 F in the dump), and a fixed value while fuel_pressure_limp_home_active_flag is set. cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture snapshots it into 0x3fd07e and engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand turns it into pilot_injection_quantity (was cm848_torque_limit_state_update).
evidence: Single reader of torque_limit_demand_output is cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture -> 0x3fd07e -> cam_timing_reference_offset = scale x 0x3fd07e / 51200, which cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation subtracts from the main quantity and uses as the x input of pilot_injection_pulse_width_grid. Table values are 29-206 counts (2-14 mm3) and the Cummins e2m database lists the same block (Pilot_Fuel_Quantity, Pilot_Quantity_*_Correction, Pilot_Fuel_State, Pilot_Quantity_Logic_Select, HPCR_Pilot_To_Main_Ratio_Limit = 2048 in the dump) at matching consecutive offsets.

plate_comment: Computes the auxiliary (third, after-main) injection quantity auxiliary_quantity_unscaled: the blended injection_quantity_auxiliary map and the coolant, ambient and boost terms are selected by max or min wins (auxiliary_quantity_logic_select: 1 = max, 2 = min), replaced by an override value when enabled, and set to 0 when crank_position_valid_flag is set with engine_sync_force_reset_cal = 1. cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture copies it to 0x3fd080 and engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand uses it, scaled, as the cap of auxiliary_injection_quantity; the winning term goes to auxiliary_quantity_source_code (was cm848_calculateGovernorOutput).
evidence: crank_sync_threshold has one reader (cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture) -> 0x3fd080 -> engine_timing_delta = min(0x40908c share x (total - pilot) / 4096, scale x 0x3fd080 / 51200); the third on-time then comes from auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_grid with x = engine_timing_delta. Grid values are 0 / 22 counts (1.5 mm3) and the e2m database lists Aux_Fuel_Quantity, Aux_Quantity_Logic_Select (1 = max wins, 2 = min wins), Aux_Quantity_Override_*, Aux_Quantity_State and Aux_Quantity_Ratio_Limit at matching offsets.

plate_comment: Computes the main injection on-time: the cylinder's main quantity (main_injection_quantity_even_event for even cylinder_event_index, main_injection_quantity_odd_event for odd), plus the pilot-to-main correction while the pilot pulse is on, is looked up against rail pressure (fuel_pressure_sensor) in main_injection_pulse_width_grid, capped at main_injection_pulse_width_maximum (giving main_injection_pulse_width_before_minimum_check) and set to 0 below the minimum on-time for that rail pressure. The result main_injection_pulse_width (0.4 us ticks) is written as the second injection event (TPU-A channel 5 slot 8) by engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel6EventHandler (was cm848_calculateTimingWithTables).
evidence: Output goes to the slot 8 parameter of TPU-A channel 5 and to fuel_quantity_demand_monitor (sum of the three on-times) and the fuel-used builders; the grid is 24 quantities x 16 rail pressures (9-180 MPa) holding tick widths; the minimum is the 1-D table at 0x5f230 (375 ticks = 150 us flat); e2m lists HPCR_Duration_Main_Injection (0.4 us) at the matching offset and HPCR_Min_Injduration_Curve for the minimum.

plate_comment: Computes the pilot injection on-time: the pilot quantity pilot_injection_quantity and rail pressure are looked up in pilot_injection_pulse_width_grid and capped at pilot_injection_pulse_width_maximum. The pilot pulse is enabled (pilot_injection_pulse_width = the width, TPU-A channel 5 slot 4) only when the width reaches the minimum on-time and the gap between pilot end and main start is at least pilot_to_main_injection_minimum_interval ticks (625 in the dump); an enabled pilot takes its quantity off the main quantity (main_injection_quantity_even_event / main_injection_quantity_odd_event), and the auxiliary quantity auxiliary_injection_quantity is always taken off (was cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation).
evidence: Reads cam_timing_reference_offset (pilot quantity) as the table x input, writes fuel_quantity_trim which engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel6EventHandler passes as the slot 4 on-time (first of three events, angle cam_sync_period_reference_a x -5 earlier than the main). e2m lists HPCR_Duration_Pilot1, HPCR_Min_Interval_Main_Pilot (625 ticks) and HPCR_Max_Pilotinj_Duration_Shiftfactor at the matching offsets.

plate_comment: Computes the auxiliary (third, after-main) injection on-time, not a fault: the auxiliary quantity auxiliary_injection_quantity (plus the main-pulse interaction correction while the main pulse is on) and rail pressure are looked up in auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_grid, set to 0 below the minimum on-time, capped at auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_maximum and stored as auxiliary_injection_pulse_width (TPU-A channel 5 slot 12). The pulse is disabled when param_1 is nonzero (its start would be past the angle limit) or the gap after the main pulse is shorter than main_to_auxiliary_injection_minimum_interval ticks (1500); when it stays off, auxiliary_injection_quantity is added back to the main quantity and the main on-time is recomputed (was cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming).
evidence: Third event is after the main: it needs (cam_sync_period_reference_b x -5) - (injection_period_capture_a x -5) > 0, the mirror of the pilot test. Writes injection_timing_active_flag as the slot 12 on-time, and calls cm848_calculateTimingWithTables to re-add the share when disabled. e2m lists HPCR_Duration_Aux, HPCR_Auxinj_Duration_Override_*, HPCR_Min_Interval_Main_Aux (1500 ticks) and HPCR_Max_Auxinj_Duration_Shiftfactor at the matching offsets.

plate_comment: Starts each cylinder event's main quantity at the total quantity (copies total_injection_quantity into main_injection_quantity_even_event for even cylinder_event_index, main_injection_quantity_odd_event for odd) and sets the maximum on-times from the crank period: main_injection_pulse_width_maximum = 2 / 3 / 4 x period / 8 by main_injection_pulse_width_maximum_shift_factor (2 / other / 4), pilot_injection_pulse_width_maximum and auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_maximum = period / 16, doubled when pilot_injection_pulse_width_maximum_shift_factor / auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_maximum_shift_factor is 2 (was cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput).
evidence: Not in my leads; found while tracing the on-time caps. Straight from the code: it has no governor or filter content, its outputs are the three on-time ceilings used by the three pulse width functions and the per-parity main quantity start value; the three cal bytes it reads sit at the e2m HPCR_Max_*inj_Duration_Shiftfactor offsets.

plate_comment: Initializes the pilot injection quantity calculation: sets the engine speed and fuel demand hysteresis followers (pilot_quantity_engine_speed_with_hysteresis, pilot_quantity_fuel_demand_with_hysteresis) to the current values and resets the interpolation states at 0x3fd10c-0x3fd13e used by cm848_calculatePilotInjectionQuantity (was cm848_initialization_fault_state).
evidence: Not in my leads. The body writes exactly the two follower variables and the 26 interpolation state words that the pilot quantity function passes to its table lookups; nothing fault related.

Written by cm848_calculateTimingWithTables from main_injection_pulse_width_grid, passed as the slot 8 on-time to engine_injectionAngle_writeTpuEvent (TPU-A channel 5 pulse width parameter), summed by fuel_quantity_demand_monitor, compared with the interval to the third pulse. Equals e2m HPCR_Duration_Main_Injection (0.4 us per count) at the same offset; it is a time, not a quantity.

Written by cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation (0 = pilot off), slot 4 on-time in the TPU event handler, y input of main_quantity_pilot_correction_grid, summed by fuel_quantity_demand_monitor. Equals e2m HPCR_Duration_Pilot1.

Word on-time written by cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming (0 = third pulse off), slot 12 on-time in the TPU event handler, summed by fuel_quantity_demand_monitor; not a flag. Equals e2m HPCR_Duration_Aux.

Main on-time from main_injection_pulse_width_grid capped at fuel_quantity_upper_limit, before the minimum-on-time cutoff that zeroes fuel_quantity_active. Read by cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming as the y input of the main-pulse interaction table and as the main-pulse-on test.

Set in cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput to 2 / 3 / 4 x (crank period >> 3) by fuel_injection_state_code and used only as the cap of the main table result in cm848_calculateTimingWithTables; a pulse width ceiling of 1/4 to 1/2 of the crank period (the e2m shift factor HPCR_Max_Maininj_Duration_Shiftfactor).

Set in cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput to crank period >> 4 (doubled when injection_timing_mode_a_cal = 2); only reader is cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation, which caps the pilot table width with it. Nothing to do with cruise control.

Set in cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput to crank period >> 4 (doubled when injection_timing_mode_b_cal = 2); only reader is cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming, which caps the third on-time with it. Nothing to do with cruise control.

Written by cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation: (main start angle - pilot start angle) x crank period / (cam_sync_position_high_byte x 256) >> 3, i.e. time from pilot start to main start in 3.2 us counts; x input of main_quantity_pilot_correction_grid (e2m HPCR_Fuelq_Corr_Map_Interval_Axis, 3.2 us).

Written by cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming: (third start angle - main start angle) converted with the crank period and shifted >> 3 (3.2 us counts); x input of the main-pulse interaction table (WORD_ARRAY_0005f8ac). Same construction as the pilot interval.

Computed in engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand (also zeroed in one other place): fuel_demand_computed_snapshot x scale / 51200 + the per-cylinder trim, clamped 0..5888 (0x1700). It is the cylinder's whole quantity (pilot + main + auxiliary): copied to engine_timing_reference_high / _low, to injection_fuel_quantity_snapshot (added to injected_fuel_running_total per injection) and used as the load axis of the injection timing tables.

Starts as total_injection_quantity (cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput, even cylinder_event_index), then cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation subtracts the pilot quantity (when the pilot is on) and the auxiliary quantity, leaving the main quantity that cm848_calculateTimingWithTables turns into the main on-time.
Same as the even-event word for odd cylinder_event_index (selected with cylinder_event_index & 1 in cm848_calculateTimingWithTables and cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput).

engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand: 0x40908c x (total - pilot) >> 12, capped at scale x 0x3fd080 / 51200 (0 if that is negative); subtracted from the main quantity, x input of auxiliary_injection_pulse_width_grid in cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming, added back to the main quantity when the third pulse stays off.

engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand: scale x 0x3fd07e (pilot quantity snapshot) / 51200, capped at total_injection_quantity. Read by cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation (x input of pilot_injection_pulse_width_grid, subtracted from the main quantity) and by engine_injectionAngle_computeLoadCh6 (nonzero = the first scheduled event is the pilot).

Outside the five functions. Only users are engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand (slews it toward a fuel-demand dependent target, step limit DAT_00408f4e, then multiplies fuel_demand_computed_snapshot, the pilot snapshot and the auxiliary snapshot by it / 51200) and cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture (resets it to 51200 = 1.0 outside the governor-setpoint cold start phases). It scales quantities, not timing.

Only user cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation: pilot enabled only if (pilot-start to main-start interval - pilot width) >= this, in ticks (625 = 250 us in the dump). Matches e2m HPCR_Min_Interval_Main_Pilot (0.4 us). Not EEPROM-backed, so no _cal.

Only user cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming: third pulse allowed only if the gap after the main pulse is at least this many ticks (1500 = 600 us in the dump). Matches e2m HPCR_Min_Interval_Main_Aux. It is a time, not a quantity threshold.
Only user cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput: value 2 doubles the pilot maximum on-time (period / 16 -> period / 8). Matches e2m HPCR_Max_Pilotinj_Duration_Shiftfactor. Not EEPROM-backed.

Byte cal read only by cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput: 2 / 3 / 4 selects the main maximum on-time 2 / 3 / 4 x (period / 8) (3 in the dump). Matches e2m HPCR_Max_Maininj_Duration_Shiftfactor; never written, so not a state.
Only user cm848_selectGovernorFilterOutput: value 2 doubles the auxiliary maximum on-time (2 in the dump). Matches e2m HPCR_Max_Auxinj_Duration_Shiftfactor. Not EEPROM-backed.
Byte read in cm848_calculateTimingWithTables: nonzero replaces the table width with the next word. Matches e2m HPCR_Maininj_Duration_Override_Switch at the same offset. Not EEPROM-backed.
Word at an odd address right after the switch byte; main on-time used when the override switch is set (cm848_calculateTimingWithTables). Matches e2m HPCR_Maininj_Duration_Override_Value.
Byte read in cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation; matches e2m HPCR_Pilotinj_Duration_Override_Switch.
Pilot on-time used when the pilot override switch is set (cm848_calculateEngineTimingInterpolation); matches e2m HPCR_Pilotinj_Duration_Override_Value.
Byte read in cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming; matches e2m HPCR_Auxinj_Duration_Override_Switch.
Auxiliary on-time used when the override switch is set (cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming); matches e2m HPCR_Auxinj_Duration_Override_Value.

Read in three places: state 2 of engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel6EventHandler adds the main on-time (as an angle) to the third start angle when the value is nonzero, state 4 adds it when the value is 0 (opposite polarity), and cm848_calculateEngineFaultTiming subtracts the main on-time from the interval when it is 0. The e2m flag Aux_SOI_End_Of_Main_Adjust ('adjust Aux SOI to be relative to Main EOI') is the likely meaning, but the state 4 polarity does not fit, so no name until the handler's two angle paths are traced. Value 1 in the dump.

ROM 1-D table (word[9], byte length 16 + 8 breakpoints 0..2866 counts = 0..140 MPa) used as the x axis of the minimum-on-time lookup with fuel_pressure_sensor in all three pulse width functions (their only users). Matches e2m HPCR_Min_Injduration_Curve_Fuelpr_Axis (MPa 0.0488). ROM, so no _cal; nothing to do with cam sync.

ROM 1-D values of the minimum on-time: 375 ticks (150 us) at every rail pressure; each pulse width function zeroes its on-time when the table result is below it. Matches e2m HPCR_Min_Injduration_Curve_Duration_Axis (uSEC 0.4). ROM, so no _cal.

The pilot injection quantity before the injection_quantity_scale_factor and the cap at the total (the later stage is pilot_injection_quantity = cam_timing_reference_offset). One reader (cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture). Equals e2m Pilot_Fuel_Quantity (0x01806A02, 0.0679 mm3) at the matching offset in the block.

cm848_filterInputValue result of the four selectable pilot_quantity_map_N tables (current / target map index) against pilot_quantity_base_map; first term of the arbitration. e2m Pilot_Base_Fuel_Quantity (offset +0 of the pilot block).

Q12 factor (4096 = 1.0) from pilot_quantity_coolant_factor_grid (x coolant, y intake temperature), or from the cold-start curve while cranking with torque_limit_cold_start_table_select = 0; multiplied with the coolant map value >> 12. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Cool_Corr_Factor (UNITLESS 1/4096).
(DAT_0040b940 coolant map value x torque_limit_timing_warmup_correction) >> 12: a quantity in 0.0679 mm3 counts, one of the arbitration terms. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Cool_Corr_Value (MM3S).

(pilot_quantity_intake_temperature_map value x intake temperature factor) >> 12 with the factor from the 1-D pilot_quantity_intake_temperature_factor table: a quantity, not a slew. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Air_Temp_Correction.

Larger of the coolant and the intake temperature corrections (code takes the max), one input of the sum / max / min arbitration. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Temp_Correction: 'Max wins of coolant and air temp pilot qty corrections'.

Output of pilot_quantity_boost_map (x engine speed with hysteresis, y fuel demand with hysteresis): 59 / 88 / 103 / 206 counts = 4-14 mm3, a quantity, not a factor. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Boost_Precorr (MM3S).

Output of pilot_quantity_boost_factor_grid (x engine speed, y cm848_calculateBoostPressure); values 3277 = 1.0 up to 6554 = 2.0 with the divisor 3276 in the product. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Boost_Factor (1/3276.8).
dword: boost factor x boost map value / 3276 = the boost quantity term of the arbitration (4-14 mm3 at no boost). e2m Pilot_Quantity_Boost_Correction (4 bytes, MM3S).

Q12 factor from pilot_quantity_cold_correction_factor_grid (x coolant, y intake temperature) multiplied with the cold correction map value. e2m calls this block Pilot_Quantity_AECD_Corr_Factor; keep the campaign's cold_correction wording to match the table names.

(DAT_0040b95c cold correction map value x factor) >> 12, combined with the main arbitration result by torque_limit_boost_load_corr_mode (0 add, 1 max wins, 2 min wins). e2m Pilot_Quantity_AECD_Corr_Value.
Selects how the pilot terms combine: 0 sum, 1 max wins, 2 min wins (2 in the dump); only user is the pilot function. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Logic_Select. 0x409e64 is not EEPROM-backed, no _cal.

Value (88 counts = 6 mm3 in the dump) the pilot quantity takes while engine_sync_fault_active_flag is set; that flag is the fuel pressure limp home flag, not a sync fault. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Fuelpr_Limp_Home_Default: 'Pilot fuel qty. = this if in fuel press limp home'.

(pilot_quantity_ambient_map value x ambient factor) >> 12 inside cm848_torque_limit_state_update, the third term of the arbitration; only user is that function. e2m Pilot_Quantity_Ambient_Correction (offset 0x12 of the pilot block).

Written in cm848_torque_limit_state_update with the winning term: 1 map blend, 2 coolant, 3 intake temperature, 4 ambient, 5 boost, 6 cold-start coolant curve, 7 override, 11 sum, 13 ratio cap reached, 14 forced zero or negative, 15 fuel pressure limp home, 16 / 17 cold correction, 19 cold-start override; packed with the other event source codes by cm848_updateEngineStatusFlags. e2m Pilot_Fuel_State.
Follows current_rpm but only moves once the difference exceeds the step (current -/+ step): a dead band, not a slew. x input of every pilot_quantity map. e2m RPM_With_Hyst.
Same dead-band follower on fuel_demand_computed (tracks exactly below 4 x step); y input of every pilot_quantity map. e2m Fuel_With_Hyst.
Dead-band width of the engine speed follower. e2m Pilot_RPM_Hyst (RPM 0.125) at the matching offset.
Dead-band width of the fuel demand follower. e2m Pilot_Fuel_Hyst (MM3S) at the matching offset.
0 adds the cold correction term, 1 max wins, 2 min wins, 3 none (1 in the dump); only user is the pilot function. e2m Pilot_Quantity_AECD_Logic_Select (default none = 3).

While cold_start_phase is above-rpm-trigger / via-events / setpoint-underrun: 0 uses the cold-start coolant factor curve, 1 replaces the result with the cold-start override map (0 in the dump). e2m Pilot_Quantity_Crank_Logic_Select.

Writer cm848_checkProtectionFaultConditions sets it when any of 8 registered faults is enabled in engine_sync_enable_mask; one of them is fault 333 (fault_registered_bits_320_to_335 & 0x2000), which firmware/CLAUDE.md gives as P0251 fuel metering, the rail pressure actuator. The three readers are all fuel pressure limp-home substitutions: the pilot quantity default (DAT_00409e68), the main timing addend (DAT_00409e7c when set / DAT_00409e7e when clear, e2m Main_SOI_Fuelpr_Derate_Default / _No_Derate) and injection_timing_demand_cyl5 fault / normal. e2m HPCR_Fuelpr_Limp_Home is a one-byte flag: 'loss of fuelpr control resulting in timing & pilot qty adjust'. The other 7 fault bits were not decoded.

dword Q16 accumulator that the pilot function moves toward the arbitrated target by the increase / decrease steps and then clamps to 0..fuel_demand_computed << 16; its high half is the pilot result. See the type note.

Output of cm848_calculateGovernorOutput, one reader (cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture -> 0x3fd080 -> cap of engine_timing_delta). The auxiliary quantity before scaling and before the ratio cap. e2m Aux_Fuel_Quantity (0x0180C402) at the same offset in the block; the lead called it a limit and it does act as the upper bound of the auxiliary share, but Cummins names it the quantity.

cm848_filterInputValue result of the four injection_quantity_auxiliary_map_N tables against the base map; first term of the max / min selection. e2m Aux_Base_Fuel_Quantity (offset +0 of the aux block).
injection_quantity_auxiliary_coolant_factor_grid (x coolant, y intake temperature) Q12 factor; only used in cm848_calculateGovernorOutput. e2m Aux_Quantity_Cool_Corr_Factor; not a cylinder 6 value.

injection_quantity_auxiliary_coolant_limit_grid output (x engine speed, y fuel demand), the quantity multiplied by the coolant factor. e2m Aux_Quantity_Cool_Setpoint (output of the cool setpoint map).
(coolant factor x coolant map value) >> 12, the coolant term of the selection (arbitration code 2). e2m Aux_Quantity_Cool_Corr_Value.
ambient factor x ambient limit map value / 4096 clamped 0..5888, the ambient term (arbitration code 4). e2m Aux_Quantity_Ambient_Correction (offset 0xE). Not a governor limit.
dword: boost factor x 10 x boost map value / 32768, the boost term (arbitration code 5). e2m Aux_Quantity_Boost_Correction (4 bytes at offset 0x10). Not a governor limit.
injection_quantity_auxiliary_boost_factor_grid output (x engine speed, y boost pressure), scaled x 10 / 32768 in the product. e2m Aux_Quantity_Boost_Factor (1/3276.8); not a crank rpm value.
injection_quantity_auxiliary_boost_limit_grid output (x engine speed, y fuel demand), the quantity multiplied by the boost factor. e2m Aux_Quantity_Boost_Precorr.

Written 3 times in cm848_calculateGovernorOutput, never read in code: 14 forced zero (crank_position_valid_flag set with the switch on), 7 override, 1 map blend, 2 coolant, 4 ambient, 5 boost. Diagnostic of which term controls the auxiliary quantity; e2m Aux_Quantity_State at offset 0xC.

== 2 takes the minimum of the four terms, otherwise the maximum (1 = max wins in the dump). e2m Aux_Quantity_Logic_Select (1 = max wins, 2 = min wins). Only user is the auxiliary quantity function; not EEPROM-backed.

text: Cross-check source for all the proposals above: output/e2m_parameters.csv (Cummins Calterm parameter database for the same ECM family). Its consecutive blocks line up one-for-one with CM848 RAM: pilot variables 0x01806A00-0x01806A24 = CM848 0x40b938-0x40b95c (Pilot_Base_Fuel_Quantity, Pilot_Fuel_Quantity, cool corr factor / value / setpoint, Fuel_With_Hyst, RPM_With_Hyst, air temp, temp, ambient, Max_Pilot_Fuel, boost precorr / factor / correction (4 bytes), Pilot_Fuel_State, AECD factor / value / setpoint); aux variables 0x0180C400 = 0x40b814-0x40b82a; durations HPCR_Duration_Main_Injection / Pilot1 / Aux (0.4 us) at 0x01805B00 = 0x40b85c-0x40b860; calibrations 0x01805F00 = 0x409e4a-0x409e6c, 0x0180C300 = 0x409086-0x40908e, 0x01804C00 = 0x4090d0-0x4090df. Use these names for neighbouring globals. The match is by consecutive block layout (offsets and sizes, including the two dword fields), checked against the code behaviour and the RAM dump values; it is NOT by address, since the e2m virtual addresses are not CM848 addresses (the project's standing note against e2m cross-referencing is about address lookups).

Unnamed (DAT_) cells in the same chain, not in global_variables.csv, suggested names: 0x3fd07e pilot_quantity_unscaled_snapshot and 0x3fd080 auxiliary_quantity_unscaled_snapshot (written by cm848_fuel_demand_state_capture, read only by engine_injectionAngle_updateCutoutAndTimingDemand); 0x40908c auxiliary_quantity_ratio_limit (Aux_Quantity_Ratio_Limit, 2662 / 4096 = 0.65 of total minus pilot); 0x409e66 pilot_to_main_quantity_ratio_limit (HPCR_Pilot_To_Main_Ratio_Limit, 2048 = 0.5); 0x40b94c pilot_quantity_maximum (Max_Pilot_Fuel = ratio x fuel_demand_computed / 4096); 0x40b940 pilot_quantity_coolant_map_value; 0x40b95c pilot_quantity_cold_correction_map_value; 0x40b95e pilot_quantity_cold_start_override_value; 0x409e4a / 0x409e4c pilot_quantity_override_switch / pilot_quantity_override_value; 0x409e5a / 5c / 5e / 60 / 62 Pilot_Shutoff_Acceleration / Pilot_Shutoff_Road_Speed (256 = 1 mph) / Pilot_Shutoff_Coolant_Temp (19200 = 300 F, so the free-acceleration shutoff is effectively off in the dump) / Pilot_Shutoff_Intake_Temp / Pilot_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch.

More rename candidates beyond the 10-per-function cap, same evidence: 0x00409086 crank_sync_threshold_override_enable_cal -> auxiliary_quantity_override_switch; 0x00409088 crank_sync_threshold_override_cal -> auxiliary_quantity_override_value; 0x0040908e engine_sync_force_reset_cal -> auxiliary_quantity_speed_limp_home_switch (1 = auxiliary off during speed limp home, e2m Aux_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch; 0 in the dump); 0x00409e4e timing_limit_slew_decrease_step_q16 -> pilot_quantity_slew_decrease_step_q16 and 0x00409e52 timing_limit_slew_increase_step_q16 -> pilot_quantity_slew_increase_step_q16 (Pilot_Quantity_Max_Decrement / Max_Increment); 0x003fd108 timing_limit_arbitrated_target -> pilot_quantity_arbitrated_target. None of these addresses is EEPROM-backed (0x3fd482-0x3feec1), so no _cal.

Type note (no change proposed here): timing_limit_slew_q16 (0x3fd104) and timing_limit_arbitrated_target (0x3fd108) are typed word in global_variables.csv but cm848_torque_limit_state_update reads and writes them as dwords (Q16), which is the source of the 'Globals starting with _ overlap smaller symbols' warning and the leading-underscore rendering. torque_limit_timing_load_correction and governor_fuel_demand_limit_hi are already dword. injection_timing_override_value_cal (0x4090d5) is a word at an odd address (calibration block packed after a byte).

crank_position_valid_flag (0x40b7d6) left uncertain: the pilot and auxiliary functions gate their zero output on it together with the Pilot_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch / Aux_Speed_Limp_Home_Switch cals (so it looks like 'running on the backup speed sensor / speed limp home'; mpc555_initEngineCrankSequence sets it to 1 while disabling TPU-A channel 0 and enabling channel 1), but it has 16 users in the crank state machines and its meaning needs its own trace.
